detail: Copy of Newspaper Publication - Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication for Issue of advertisement in newspapers regarding the Reminder notice for payment of outstanding first call money (if any) and second and final call on partly paid-up equity shares of Adani Enterprises Limited pursuant to the rights issue of the Company
